verdict.rationale: Carta is a SaaS platform holding sensitive cap table and fund data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of retention settings, deletion endpoints, data-export-and-purge workflows, or retention policies for data reached through the MCP plugins. The docs cover OAuth access, read endpoints, draft creation and the data warehouse, and community posts about cancellation friction and staff access to data do not describe any retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
